title: 第6章  剑道传承
content_zh:
“灭庞家？”
楚山惊愕得都忍不住笑了。
他拍了拍楚弛的肩膀，笑着道：“努力吧，未来是你们年轻人的。”
说着，楚山大步离去。
楚弛知道，爷爷没将他的话当回事，他像是想到了什么，开口问道：“爷爷，我哥不知道我的事情吗？”
院子里这么多人，但楚弛一直没有看见他的亲哥哥，楚天。
“不知道。”
楚弛呼出了一口气：“这么说，他还在野兽山岭，不知道就好，不然，这些天，他得多难过。”
楚弛从小到大，最亲的人，只有楚天。
他的母亲，在他三岁的时候，跟别的男人跑了。这事情，一直都是村里的笑话。
楚家因为此事，被庞家人笑话了好一阵子。
之后，他爹外出寻找，从此杳无音讯，生死未知。
就像楚南说的那样，他有爹娘生，无爹娘养。
他能当一个纨绔，完全是因为，他有一个修为不弱的哥哥。
楚天年仅二十三，已经是凡人境六层的修为。
这些年，楚家同辈虽然经常嘲讽楚弛，看不起楚弛，却也不敢对楚弛做太过分的事情，就因为他哥哥天赋不弱，备受楚山的期待。
楚弛知道，这些年，他哥哥过得很累很累。
除了修炼，就是修炼。
因为他哥比谁都明白，在这个世界，没有实力，就不会受任何人待见！
他如果不努力，楚弛在楚家的处境，会更加难。

甚至，他们两兄弟，怕是早就被赶出楚家了。
“哥，你护了我十几年，或许今后，轮到我保护你了。”
止住心中的想法，楚弛回到了偏院。
这，就是他和楚天的家。
他站在院子里，开始领悟女剑仙传给他的剑道传承。
这传承，是一种剑道境界。
他手持一根树枝，闭着眼睛，安静站在院子里。
同一时间，庞家。
庞妃烟一回到庞家，就忍不住低吼道。
“爷爷，我要杀了楚弛！我要杀了他。”
庞庆洋皱眉道：“要杀楚弛，只有先灭楚家。”
“那就灭了吧！”
庞庆洋却是摇了摇头：“就算我们庞家的整体实力，强于楚家一点，但灭楚家，我庞家必遭重创。这时候，要是有别的势力闻讯赶来飞云村，我庞家，死路一条。”
“爷爷，那就这么算了吗？”
“不算了还能怎样？除非，飞云村有建立私家村的名额！”
庞庆洋说到私家村的时候，眼神里满是光芒。
私家村，也就是让飞云村，改名为庞家村。
意味着这个村子，庞姓为王。
庞家的旗帜，可以插在村口，随风飘扬。
而他庞庆洋，将成为村子里，唯一的村长。

村长，王国最小的官职。
但，官职再小，也是被官方认可的。
所有庶民，皆不可忤逆村长之家。
将家族发展成为私家村，那是多少小家族的梦想啊。
但，建立私家村的名额，非常少。
想要得到这个建村的名额，只能靠运气。
“爷爷，你倒是提醒我了，我好像听风哥说过，过段时间，上面要给建村名额。飞云村，很可能能分到其中一个！”
“什么！妃烟，你说的是真的？”
庞庆洋瞬间就变得激动了，他的小眼睛，变得大了不少。
“是真的，上次风哥临走前，提过一嘴。但他说，等事情弄清楚了、确定了，他再告诉我。”
“那什么时候能确定？这都已经七天过去了。”
“风哥说，最多也就十天半个月。”
“十天半月吗？”
庞庆洋眼里射出一道精光。
“爷爷，如果真有建村名额……”
“如果真有名额，我自然要灭了楚家。整个村子，只有他楚家有资格同我们抢这个名额！现在，就等禹风的消息了。”
“爷爷，到时候楚弛留给我，我要亲手杀了他。还有，今天的事情，可别告诉风哥，我怕他会忍不住，替我杀了楚弛。楚弛那个废物，在风哥手里，走不过一招。”
“放心，我不会提。好了，现在我就得去计划计划，如果真有建村名额，我必须率先想好计策，以最小的代价，灭掉楚家。”
时间流逝，天色黑了下来。
楚弛依旧站在院子里，手持树枝，一动不动。

这样的动作，他已经保持了好几个小时了。
忽然，他睁开了双眼。
手中的树枝，被他仍在了地上。
他咧嘴一笑道：“原来所谓的剑道传承，根本不是武技，而是对剑的一种领悟。这么说，我得去武技房领取一门剑技。”
轻喃着，楚弛前往了武技房。
武技房门口，有一位老者守护。
“木爷爷，我来选一本武技！”
“楚弛啊，你的事情我听说了。跳崖未死，还成为了修者，这是说书先生嘴里才有的故事。说不定，你真的走运了。来吧，我带你进去。”
楚家的武技房，非常小。
整个武技房，只有不到二十本武技。
其中，人级下品武技十四本。
人级中品武技，六本。
人级上品和极品武技，一本都没有。
对于弱小的势力来说，武技非常珍贵，越高级，越难寻。
“居然没有上品武技！”
楚弛有些无语。
早知道当时离开山谷的时候，让女剑仙给他传一些低等级的武技！
但仔细一想，这么低等级的武技，女剑仙哪里会有。
听女剑仙说，她一修炼，就是绝世妖孽，配合师门的绝世丹药，几天就能提升好几个大境界。
那些弱小的武技，她估计看都没看过。

“你小子，居然想学上品武技，你可知道，上品武技，非凡人境七层不可学。大部分修者，凡人境九层才学得会。另外，楚家也只有一本上品武技，在你爷爷那里，想学需要他口传。”
“要去找爷爷？”
楚弛皱起了眉头，他现在就去找楚山，楚山怕也不会传给他。
谁会信他一个凡人境三层的修者，能越级学会人级上品武技啊。
这种人，不是没有，但每一个都是传说中的武道奇才。
楚弛懒得自找麻烦，他仔细打量了一下书架上的人级中品武技，眼神猛然一亮，他指着一本保存得很好的武技，开口道。
“木爷爷，我学这本！”
木爷爷一看，惊讶地道：“你要学《七剑斩》……”
“怎么了？”
“娃娃呀，这可是剑技！剑技是公认的最难学的武技之一。这《七剑斩》摆在这里三十年，不知道劝退了多少人。你爷爷这么多年来，也只学会了四剑而已。”
“是吗？那我决定了，就学它！”
“你小子……行，既然你要学，那就学吧。这《七剑斩》，要是你能施展出三剑，就有中品武技之威，要是能施展出七剑，它的威力，绝对不弱于任何上品武”技！”
五分钟后，楚弛带着七剑斩，和另外两本人级中品武技，回到了院子里。
一回去，他就开始舞剑。
一剑起，风飞扬。
尘土如蛇，随风而上。
逐渐的，月色下出现一道璀璨剑影。
起初，剑影只有一道。
但随后，两道，三道，四道……
content_en:
"Destroy the Pang family?"
Chu Shan was so shocked that he couldn't help but laugh.
He patted Chu Chi on the shoulder and said with a smile: "Work hard, the future belongs to you young people."
With that said, Chu Shan strode away.
Chu Chi knew that grandpa didn't take his words seriously. He seemed to have thought of something and asked, "Grandpa, doesn't my brother know about me?"
There were so many people in the yard, but Chu Chi never saw his brother, Chu Tian.
"I don't know."
Chu Chi exhaled: "So, he is still in Beast Mountain. It's better not to know. Otherwise, he will be so sad these days."
From childhood to adulthood, the only person Chu Chi was closest to was Chu Tian.
His mother ran away with another man when he was three years old. This matter has always been a joke in the village.
The Chu family was laughed at by the Pang family for a long time because of this incident.
After that, his father went out to look for him, but there was no news from him and his life and death were unknown.
Just like Chu Nan said, he was born with his parents, but he has no parents to support him.
He can be a dandy entirely because he has an older brother who is not weak in cultivation.
Chu Tian was only twenty-three years old and was already at the sixth level of the mortal realm.
Over the years, although Chu family peers often mocked Chu Chi and looked down on Chu Chi, they did not dare to do anything too excessive to Chu Chi, just because his brother was not weak in talent and was highly anticipated by Chu Shan.
Chu Chi knew that his brother had been very tired over the past few years.
In addition to cultivation, it is cultivation.
Because his brother understands better than anyone else that in this world, if you don’t have strength, you won’t be treated well by anyone!
If he doesn't work hard, Chu Chi's situation in the Chu family will be even more difficult.
In fact, the two brothers were probably kicked out of the Chu family long ago.
"Brother, you have protected me for more than ten years. Maybe in the future, it will be my turn to protect you."
Stopping his thoughts, Chu Chi returned to the side courtyard.
This is his and Chutian's home.
He stood in the yard and began to understand the swordsmanship inheritance passed down to him by the female sword fairy.
This inheritance is a realm of swordsmanship.
He was holding a branch and standing quietly in the yard with his eyes closed.
At the same time, the Pang family.
As soon as Pang Feiyan returned to Pang's house, she couldn't help but growl.
"Grandpa, I want to kill Chu Chi! I want to kill him."
Pang Qingyang frowned and said, "To kill Chu Chi, we have to destroy the Chu family first."
"Then destroy it!"
Pang Qingyang shook his head: "Even if the overall strength of our Pang family is slightly stronger than that of the Chu family, if the Chu family is destroyed, our Pang family will suffer heavy losses. At this time, if other forces hear the news and come to Feiyun Village, my Pang family will die."
"Grandpa, is that all?"
"What else can I do? Unless Feiyun Village has a quota to build a private village!"
When Pang Qingyang talked about private villages, his eyes were filled with light.
The private village, that is, Rang Feiyun Village, was renamed Pangjia Village.
It means that in this village, the surname Pang is the king.
The flag of the Pang family can be planted at the entrance of the village and flutter in the wind.
And he, Pang Qingyang, will become the only village chief in the village.
Village chief, the smallest official position in the kingdom.
However, no matter how small the official position is, it is still officially recognized.
All common people must not disobey the village chief's family.
It is the dream of many small families to develop their family into a private village.
However, the quota for establishing private villages is very small.
If you want to get this quota for building a village, you can only rely on luck.
"Grandpa, you reminded me. I think I heard Brother Feng say that after a while, the higher authorities will give quotas for village construction. Feiyun Village will probably be allocated one of them!"
"What! Feiyan, are you telling the truth?"
Pang Qingyang became excited instantly, and his little eyes became much bigger.
"It's true. Brother Feng mentioned it before he left last time. But he said that he would tell me when things are clear and confirmed."
"When will it be confirmed? It's been seven days."
"Brother Feng said, it's only ten days and a half at most."
“Ten days and a half month?? "
Pang Qingyang's eyes shot out with a ray of light.
"Grandpa, if there really is a quota for village building..."
“If there really is a quota, I will naturally destroy the Chu family. In the entire village, only his Chu family is qualified to compete with us for this spot! Now, just wait for news from Yu Feng. "
"Grandpa, when Chu Chi is left to me, I will kill him with my own hands. Also, don’t tell Brother Feng what happened today, I’m afraid he won’t be able to bear it and kill Chu Chi for me. Chu Chi, that good-for-nothing, can't stand a single move in Brother Feng's hands. "
“Don’t worry, I won’t mention it. Okay, now I have to make plans. If there is really a quota for building a village, I must be the first to think of a strategy to destroy the Chu family at the minimum cost. "
Time passed and it became dark.
Chu Chi was still standing in the yard, holding a branch, motionless.
He had been doing this for several hours.
Suddenly, he opened his eyes.
The branch in his hand was still on the ground.
He grinned and said: "It turns out that the so-called sword inheritance is not a martial skill at all, but an understanding of the sword. So, I have to go to the martial arts room to get a sword skill. "
Muttering softly, Chu Chi went to the martial arts room.
There is an old man guarding the door of the martial arts room.
"Grandpa Mu, let me choose a martial arts book! "
"Chu Chi, I heard about you. He jumped off a cliff and did not die, but also became a cultivator. This is a story only told by storytellers. Maybe, you are really lucky. Come on, I'll take you inside. "
The Chu family's martial arts room is very small.
There are less than twenty martial arts in the entire martial arts room.
Among them, there are fourteen books on low-grade human-level martial arts.
Six copies of mid-level human-level martial arts.
There is not a single top-level human-level or top-level martial arts skill.
For weak forces, martial arts are very precious. The higher the level, the harder it is to find.
“You actually don’t have top-grade martial arts skills! "
Chu Chi was speechless.
If he had known that when he left the valley, he would have asked the female sword fairy to teach him some low-level martial arts skills!
But if you think about it carefully, how could a female swordsman possess such low-level martial arts skills?
I heard from the female sword fairy that once she practices, she becomes a peerless monster. With her master's peerless elixir, she can rise to several great realms in a few days.
She probably has never seen those weak martial arts.
"You kid, you actually want to learn high-grade martial arts. Do you know that high-grade martial arts cannot be learned at the seventh level of the Extraordinary Realm? Most cultivators can only learn it when they are at the ninth level of the mortal realm. In addition, the Chu family only has one high-grade martial arts book, which your grandfather has to teach you orally if you want to learn it. "
"Going to find grandpa? "
Chu Chi frowned. He would go find Chu Shan now, but Chu Shan might not pass it on to him.
Who would believe that he, a cultivator at the third level of the mortal realm, could leapfrog the level and learn high-grade human-level martial arts?
There are no such people, but every one of them is a legendary martial arts wizard.
Chu Chi was too lazy to ask for trouble. He carefully looked at the mid-level human-level martial arts on the bookshelf. His eyes suddenly lit up. He pointed to a well-preserved martial arts book and said.
“Grandpa Mu, I’ll learn this book! "
Grandpa Mu looked at it and said in surprise: "You want to learn "Seven Swordsman"..."
"What's wrong? "
"Baby, this is a sword skill! Sword skills are recognized as one of the most difficult martial arts to learn. This "Seven Swords Slash" has been here for thirty years, and I don't know how many people have been persuaded to quit. Your grandfather has only learned the four swords in all these years. "
"Yeah? Then I decided to learn it! "
"You kid... okay, since you want to learn, then learn it. This "Seven Swords Slash", if you can perform three swords, it will have the power of a middle-grade martial arts. If you can perform the Seven Swords, its power will definitely not be weaker than any high-grade martial arts!"
Five minutes later, Chu Chi returned to the yard with Seven Sword Slash and two other human-level mid-level martial arts skills.
As soon as he returned, he began to dance with his sword.
With a sword, the wind flies.
Dust is like a snake, carried up by the wind.
Gradually, a bright sword shadow appeared under the moonlight.
at first, there is only one sword shadow.
But then, two, three, four...
